Bits of Miki's past is shown, and she follows Kippei to "Go to School Day". Miki sees Kippei kissing Kokoro and changes back to her old mean self. Miki heads home and tricks Yu into leaving with her.

20.o: Miki takes Yu to her house as Kippei and his family wait, hoping that Miki hadn't stolen Yu away. Kippei goes to pick them up after Miki tells him where they are, during the time it takes him to get there more of Miki's past is revealed. When Kippei gets there Miki says she's going to kill herself and he talks her down. Later Miki and her parents make up.

21.o: Kokoro is mad at Kippei for not calling her even once over the summer like he has promised to do. Kokoro's friends tell Kippei that Kokoro is popular with the guys so he had better start acting like a real boyfriend or Kokoro would be swept off her feet by another man. Miki comes back for her things, now a happy girl, and watched Kokoro before she leaves to go home.

22.o: Kippei catches a cold. A model in Satsuki's class likes him. A little of Kippei's childhood is shown as his family tells Yu of it. Satsuki's model friend is told by other girls he doesn't like tall girls, girls with long hair, or models, which breaks her heart. Later she tells him she likes him.

23.o: Kippei makes two box lunches, one for Yu and one for Kokoro. Kokoro gives her homemade lunch to Kippei in return for him making one for her. During eating she gets a phone call that depresses her. Marika gets picked on by one of her friends at class but Yu tells her she's still her friend and that she likes her. Kokoro tells Kippei she doesn't want to get any closer to him.

24.t: A letter to the one you love
24.o: Yu's letter cheers Kippei up and Kippei decides to write a letter to Kokoro so she can feel his feelings more. Kokoro doesn't show up at school the next day, and some of her past with her mother is shown.

25.o: Yu has a dream and realizes she doesn't remember what her mother's face looks like and starts to miss her mother. Kippei accidentally tears Yu's pajamas, which were made by her mother. Kokoro and Yu spend some time alone with each other. Kippei's sister flies away from home.

26.o: Kokoro and Yu are still in the sandbox as they were in the last episode. Kokoro cheers Yu up. Kippei's family finally meets Kokoro and invites her to stay the night with them. Kippei's sister meets with Yu's mother. Kippei gives Yu her pajamas back all fixed up. Yu's mom and Kippei's sister talk about Yu and the problem with her pajamas. Yu's mom talks about the past and then Kippei's sister leaves for home. Kippei, Yu, and Kokoro sleep together.

1.o: Alka is chased by the Empire, and runs into Koga, who notices her skill with the blade. She's taken to their village. The village's land is great for cultivating Heaven's Spirits, so the Empire wants their land. Morii hires Alka as a bodyguard. Jin Varrel commands the Flower Monks and searches for Alka, saying she killed her master.

2.o: Wanted posters are posted in the red light district of this town of Alka. Jin Hazuki, the bounty hunter, takes Alka to the Tomon Inn. They meet the proprietress, Elle Karen. Karen realizes she's the bounty, but has a policy of leaving business outside of her establishment.

3.o: Alka and Hazuki continue to fight and run into the Pleasure Gang. Dan Loana, the leader of the gang, tells Alka that she's trying to take revenge against Jin. She tries to explain that revenge is about an emotion, not a rule, and uses Alka as bait to lure Jin in.

4.o: Seto and Pia work by collecting garbage around the red light district. They invite Alka into their house, as it seems she has lost her sight. She remembers Master Hon's teaching. One day Seto is attacked and he ends up killing his attacker and selling his goods.

5.o: Shou, a man who hates the Heaven's Spirits, hires Alka as a bodyguard and then uses her to try to persuade a village to stop producing them. However, this village depends on the Heaven's Spirits, and Shou's pleas fall on deft ears. Shou creates a plan to help things go his way...

6.o: Yuu joins an anti-gorilla force and doesn't like military action, however all the other members want to take the fight to the Empire. Jin commands the Flower Monks to set up camp to take them out. Yuu wants to stop the fight from happening, so he goes to talk to Jin...

7.o: Alka runs into Moriii again, and finds her and others collected in a place where everyone carries some sort of past pain. Morii seems like she changed, and now speaks strangely. A woman, which Morii calls mother, wants to hold a ritual to help Alka, but...

8.o: Yuu, appears in front of Alka, poisoned by the Impurity. He asks where Master Hon is and then collapses due to hunger. Alka takes him to the Pleasure Gang base, and Alka takes care of him. While talking with Yuu, Alka starts to understand Master Hon's teachings.

9.o: Alka doesn't know what to do anymore, and so Karen invites her to work at her shop. She learns what to do, and becomes close friends with Miharu. Alka starts to become more human, and realizes there's a world out there she didn't know. But she finds her lives shatter by someone.

10.o: Alka carries deep wounds because of Karen, and then runs into Hayate and his wife Hana. Hana realizes Alka is under distress, but both Hana and Hayate realize that Alka is related to something that happened to their daughter who died...

11.o: Alka suffers thinking back on everyone's words, which she had originally thought were meaningless. She returns to the Village of the Sword. Karen searches for Alka with Hazuki and Loana, but Jin Varrel seems to be approaching as well.

12.o: Jin Varrel stands before Alka once again. Karen, Hazuki, Loana fight against Jin, as Alka is no longer to fight, but they stand no match against her. Alka decides to end this once and for all. The fight continues, with no end in sight, but then Jin attacks Alka with a full blast of her Impurity...

13.o: Hazuki wins a drinking contest, and gets a treasure map showing the location of eternal beauty. Karen also gets a map from a person staying at her inn, and she heads towards a lone island in the southern sea. Pia claims that it's totally a fake, but Karen says it might be fun to search for some treasure. Loana ends up coming in search of the treasure too...

1.o: Nash'ie opens up a store to sell gasoline but his business is deemed impractical as electricity reaches homes. Khash'ie starts putting up lampposts in the streets and provides different houses in the neighborhood with electricity. A set of comic situations unfold.

2.o: Khas'ie and Nash'ie become business partners, extending electricity wires to different homes, but they face several problems as Umm Faisal accuses Nash'ie of theft and the police investigate him. As Khas'ie asks Marzouk to open the new power station, a mistake results in Marzouk being electrocuted.

3.o: Khash'ie starts working at the power station and his manager asks him to turn on the lights at night only. Khash'ie makes use of his job to cut off electricity from the houses of people he dislikes. Nash'ie shifts his business to the oil trade, but his store explodes when he gets an electric supply.

4.o: The police officer investigates Khash'ie for supplying Nash'ie's store with electricity, which ended up setting the market on fire. Al-Dawis decides to build a café in the village, but the district chief and Suweilam refuse and urge him to get the required permits first.

5.o: When Khash'ie is dismissed from his job at the gas station, he learns how to drive in the hope of landing a new job. He trains with Nash'ie on a car that he crashes into the café.

6.o: The police arrest Nash'ie for demolishing the café and breaking Mofleh's leg. Khash'ie asks Mofleh to drop the charges in exchange for money, and the policeman urges Nash'ie to pay the costs of rebuilding the café.

7.o: Nash'ie rebuilds the café. Khash'ie is hired as a driver of a water-distribution vehicle in the neighborhood.

8.o: Khash'ie suggests that Nash'ie opens up a new store in the market. Khash'ie goes swimming inside the tank of the water-distribution vehicle that provides people with drinking water.

9.o: Khash'ie rents Nash'ie's car and mixes water with oil, believing it benefits the livestock, but things take a turn for the worse when the people of the village become itchy.

10.o: When Khash'ie reports his son's disappearance, Officer Suweilam gives orders to search for the boy. The district chief has a skin disease attributed to using the water distributed by Khash'ie. The missing boy is found inside the water tank attached to the vehicle.

11.o: Khash'ie urges his son to falsely claim that he was kidnapped. Khash'ie's friend testifies that Khash'ie mixed the water with oil, causing skin irritation to the villagers. An Egyptian teacher, Bayoumy, arrives at the village to be the school principal.

12.o: Khash'ie considers suicide to make it up to Nash'ie, but as he puts his plan into action, he accidentally shoots Bayoumy, the school principal, and rushes to save him.

13.o: Officer Suweilam finds the gun that Bayoumy was shot with, and Faleh validates that it is his son Nash'ie's. Nash'ie is arrested while Khash'ie stays at Bayoumy's house to tend to him.

14.o: Principal Bayoumy hires Khash'ie at the school and he starts adding the students' names to the school database. Nash'ie tells Khash'ie that he was accused of shooting Bayoumy and that's why he was imprisoned.

15.o: Nash'ie is released when Bayoumy drops the charges against him. On the first day of school, the Arabic teacher, Bor'ei, arrives, and Bayoumy receives a telegraph from Egypt, reporting his wife's death.

16.o: Khash'ie tells the district chief that he has nominated him to teach the Islamic Religion course at school. Khash'ie catches students selling food at the school. The Captain asks Nash'ie to let him take charge of the water-supply vehicle.

17.o: Bayoumy reproaches Khash'ie for tying the students up and torturing them. Nash'ie quarrels with Saleh and Suweilam takes him into police custody. Bayoumy is shocked when Khash'ie takes all the students to the cafe.

18.o: Bayoumy is shocked to learn that Khash'ie has turned the school's warehouse into a corral to breed livestock. Nash'ie looks after Saleh until he recuperates. The Captain is upset to see Sultan bossing everyone around and taking responsibility for everything.

19.o: Doctors Henry and Victoria arrive at the village where they are to work, and the district chief meets them. Bayoumy is shocked that Khash'ie has once more used the warehouse to keep Nash'ie's camel, until it devours all the books. Khash'ie is demoted to the position of a driver to the students.

20.o: As the district chief opens a new hospital, Khash'ie overloads the school car with students, causing them to get into an accident and become the hospital's first 'visitors', while Khash'ie is arrested.

21.o: The daughter of principal Bayoumy arrives and stays at his house. Khash'ie is released, but gets fired from his job at the school. Saleh regains his eyesight as he starts his treatment at the new hospital. Zeinab returns to the village and claims ownership of the Captain's house.

22.o: Nash'ie develops a crush on the foreign doctor at the hospital and tries to approach her. Meanwhile, Khash'ie helps Zeinab with her stuff and with claiming the Captain's house. The Captain crosses paths with Fardous, the principal's daughter, and catches feelings for her.

23.o: Balquis has a heart attack and is rushed to the hospital where Victoria supervises her condition. Victoria tends to Khash'ie as well, which makes his wife suspect they're having an affair. Nash'ie is displeased when he sees Khash'ie getting closer to Victoria.

24.o: To convince Zeinab that he cares for her, Khash'ie agrees with the burglar Abu Matwa to claim that Khash'ie beat him up when he burgled Zeinab's house. Khash'ie tells the people that Captain Marzouk left his house for Bayoumy and his daughter. Balquis accepts to marry Nash'ie's father.

25.o: Victoria files a complaint against Nash'ie for creeping up on her. Preparations are made for the wedding of Balquis and Nash'ie's father, but as Khash'ie and Nash'ie have a disagreement, the wedding is canceled.

26.o: Nash'ie's father quarrels with his son who's unable to help him pay Balquis's dowry. When they eventually collect the dowry money Nash'ie's father marries Balquis.

27.o: Khash'ie convinces Nash'ie that his hand is injured, using this as an excuse to go to the hospital and meet Victoria, but they're shocked when her colleague is the one who treats the injured hand. Marzouk asks for Khash'ie's help to find a bride.

28.o: Khash'ie breaks Nash'ie's arm once more in an attempt to see Victoria. The district chief considers dyeing his beard so that Fardous would like him. Khash'ie proposes to Zeinab.

29.o: Fardous mistakenly believes that Khash'ie wants to wed her, but she's shocked to learn it is actually the district chief who wants to. Zeinab refuses to wed Khash'ie and accuses him of theft.

30.o: Zebida asks Marzouk to marry her, and right after their marriage, she passes away. The district chief's first wife quarrels with him and Fardous. Victoria tells Nash'ie that his wife, Ghazala, is pregnant. Marzouk decides to sell Zebida's house.

1.o: تستجلب الشقيقتان اليتيمتان "فاي" و"باودر" المتاعب إلى شوارع المدينة السفلية "زون" في أعقاب عملية سطو وقعت في مدينة "بيلتوفر" المرموقة.

2.t: Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved
2.ar: بعض الألغاز يُفضّل أن تُترك دون حلّ
2.o: يحاول المُخترع المثالي "جايس"، رغم تحذيرات مرشده، تطويع السحر بالعلم فيما يختبر "سيلكو" الزعيم الإجرامي مادّة قويّة.

3.t: The Base Violence Necessary for Change
3.o: تقود مواجهة ملحمية بين خصمين قديمين إلى لحظة مصيرية في تاريخ "زون"، ويخاطر "جايس" و"فيكتور" بكلّ شيء في سبيل بحثهما.

4.o: فيما تنعم "بيلتوفر" بالازدهار من تكنولوجيا ابتكراها، يفكّر "جايس" و"فيكتور" في خطوتهما القادمة، ويظهر شخص مألوف مجددًا من "زون" لنشر الفوضى.

5.t: Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy
5.o: تجول الشرطية المخادعة "كايتلين" في المدينة السفلية لتعقّب "سيلكو". أمّا "جايس"، فيجعل نفسه مستهدفًا وهو يحاول استئصال الفساد في "بيلتوفر".

6.t: When These Walls Come Tumbling Down
6.o: يقوّض تلميذ متحمّس معلّمه في المجلس بينما تتطوّر تكنولوجيا سحريّة بسرعة. ومع مطاردة السُّلطات لها، يتعيّن على "جينكس" مواجهة ماضيها.

7.o: تقابل "كايتلين" و"فاي" حليفًا في شوارع "زون" ويتوجّهون إلى معركة محمومة مع عدوّة مشتركة، ويتّخذ "فيكتور" قرارًا خطيرًا.

8.o: تتبادل "ميل"، الوريثة المنفيّة، ووالدتها الزائرة أساليب القتال، وتشكّل "كايتلين" و"فاي" تحالفًا غير متوقّع، وتمرّ "جينكس" بتغيير صادم.

9.o: مع اقتراب الحرب على نحو تحفّه المخاطر، يصل قائدا "بيلتوفر" و"زون" إلى اتّفاق نهائي، لكنّ مواجهة مصيرية تغيّر كلتا المدينتين إلى الأبد.

1.o: تصارع "فاي" و"كايتلين" للعثور على أفضل السبل للرد في أعقاب مأساة بشعة تحصد الأرواح وتصعّد التوترات بين المدينتين الشقيقتين.

2.o: تزن "المدينة السفلية" خياراتها مع تأهب "بيلتوفر" للحرب، في حين تتوارى "جينكس" عن الأنظار وترتب لخطوتها التالية. ويحدث نقاش في غاية الأهمية.

3.o: تضاعف "كايتلين" جهودها في مطاردة "جينكس"، وتوافق "أمبيزا" على عقد لقاء مصيري، وتقود بعض التغيرات في "زون" إلى اكتشاف صادم.

4.o: مع انتشار شائعات حول عودة "جينكس"، تسعى "أمبيزا" لتحقيق هدفها بحماسة متقدة ودؤوبة. فيما تتخفى "جينكس" و"سيفيكا" وتتسللان إلى قلب المخاطر.

5.o: تستيقظ "فاي" على خبر مفاجئ ويتّضح أن لمّ شمل مقلق ليس كما يبدو بالفعل، فيما تكتشف "كايتلين" أصول "البريق".

6.t: The Message Hidden Within the Pattern
6.o: تأتي مرحلة التشافي من خلال شخص مألوف... وفي مكان غريب ومجهول. وتهدد خيانة صادمة بتغيير حياة عدد لا حصر له من الأشخاص.

7.t: Pretend Like It's the First Time
7.ar: تظاهر كما لو أنها المرة الأولى
7.o: لحظات من الظلمة ولحظات تشعّ بالنور، ونظرة لما كان مقدرًا ليحدث.

8.o: تثير عاصفة وشيكة سلسلة من التحوّلات المروّعة. وفي مكان ما آخر، ما زالت شرارة الثورة متّقدة!

9.o: بين السحر والعلم والسلطة والانتقام، تتصادم الأقدار في هذا الجزء الأخير الملحمي... حتى تندلع حرب شاملة.

2.o: Guiding her through a tragedy in her great-grandmother's life, Zaman helps Leyla face her fear of drowning. In Istanbul, Ada's life turns upside down.

6.o: Ada connects with Belgin and seeks to heal from the wound that pervades her matrilineal ancestry. Sparks fly between Sevgi and Fiko.

7.o: Ada discovers her father's secret. Selim faces a dilemma that would jeopardize his chances with Ada. Tensions come to a head between Sevgi and her mom.

3.o: Ada confronts skepticism from fellow doctors. Tensions flare as unexpected visitors disrupt Leyla's peace, while Sevgi awaits critical health news.

6.o: Ada's relationship with Diyar complicates her life as she tries to navigate new personal and professional dilemmas.

Young-sim's career is on the line. She gets one chance to keep it alive by taking on a pilot reality dating program. She uses all her power and connections to find the right guests. Miraculously, one of them is a high-profile CEO of a startup company, and he turns out to be the childhood friend who left her waiting on a park bench twenty years ago.

2.o: One of the female guests gets into an accident and can't make it to Young-sim's show, causing chaos. Without any other options, Young-sim steps up and takes her place. However, she still isn't sure if Wang Kyung-te is the Kyung-tae she once knew as she faces him.

3.t: A Shameful Past Can Have a Butterfly Effect
3.o: Young-sim's pilot dating program becomes a hit. However, she becomes the laughing stock for getting zero points. While she tries to deal with her embarrassing image, a bombshell leak about the final outcome causes outrage and tarnishes Kingvely's reputation.

4.o: Kyung-tae pulls through and determines to restore Kingvely's image by agreeing to do another dating program with Young-sim. Young-sim might still have animosity toward Kyung-tae, but it's her only chance to save her career. However, an unexpected situation arises when she meets with Kyung-tae to share the program's proposal at his house.

5.o: Young-sim and Kyung-tae get caught in a pickle, almost naked. Chae-dong and Wol-sook sense something strange between them and vow never to leave them alone together. Meanwhile, the team meeting for Young-sim's new program with Kingvely goes nowhere, and Wol-sook suggests going on a work retreat.

6.o: Things get a little tipsy and revealing at the work retreat. But Kyung-tae shows his knowledge in dating and wins everyone's hearts. Out of Kyung-tae's chaos, Young-sim thinks of a brilliant idea for the dating program and calls it "Love, Mark." They pitch it to the director with high hopes.

7.o: The first episode of "Love, Mark" gets underway. However, the two cast members have a hard time making it happen and give the production crew a hard time. To solve the problem, Wol-sook uses jealousy to stir their emotions.

8.t: Even a Humiliating Past is Still My Past
8.o: Kyung-tae and Chae-dong chase after Ki-ho, who took off with the footage and Young-sim. They catch up and save Young-sim and persuade Ki-ho to let his episode go on air. Young-sim returns the favour and finds someone else who would gladly meet Ki-ho on a blind date.

9.t: We Were Someone's Young-sim And Kyung-tae
9.o: Min-ji and Woo-chan's episode begins filming, but Kyung-tae's personality gets in the way. As Young-sim and Kyung-tae try to make things work between Min-ji and Woo-chan, they can't help but realize the similarity to their brief childhood romance. Meanwhile, Woo-chan learns what happened in the past, and Young-sim goes on a date.

10.o: Young-sim and Kyung-tae fall deeply for each other. Despite their happy days as a couple, another incident occurs that tests their relationship again. Wol-sook schemes to make reporters write articles that say she and Kyung Tae are dating. Although Kyung-tae wants to get the facts straight, Young-sim sees this as an opportunity to promote her show.

1.o: تُحقق المراهقة بيب فيتز-أموبي في اختفاء أندي بيل، التي يُفترض أنها قُتلت على يد صديقها سال سينغ قبل خمس سنوات. بيب مصممة على إثبات عكس ذلك.

2.o: بعد أن أصبحا فريقًا، يوجّه بيب ورافي اهتمامهما إلى أفضل أصدقاء أندي، ويكتشفان أن أندي كانت تخفي سرًا لم يكن سال راضيًا عنه. في هذه الأثناء، يتلقى بيب تحذيرًا مجهول المصدر.

3.o: عندما تتبع بيب خيوطاً جديدة في القضية، فإنها تخاطر أكثر وتدخل عالم الجنس والمخدرات وموسيقى الروك أند رول.

4.o: يكتشف بيب ورافي المزيد عن حياة أندي السرية، وعندما تُعرض على بيب قطعة جديدة من الأدلة، تصل إلى نقطة حرجة وتشكك فيما إذا كان سال مذنبًا

5.o: تكتشف بيب أكثر مما كانت تتوقعه، وتواجه عواقب وخيمة عندما تحاول مواجهة القاتل. وفي اللحظة التي يبدو فيها كل شيء قد ضاع، تتكشف الحقيقة المُرّة.

6.o: يجب على بيب أن تتقبل عواقب حل القضية. لكن ثمة شيء مريب، فتُعرّض بيب نفسها للخطر مرة أخرى لكشف الحقيقة كاملة.

1.o: تحاول بيب العودة إلى حياتها الطبيعية والتركيز على أصدقائها ومدرستها ورافي. ولكن عندما يختفي شاهد رئيسي في محاكمة ماكس هاستينغز، تشعر بيب بجاذبية قضية جديدة.

2.o: تصل بيب إلى طريق مسدود وتعيد التفكير. وبالبحث في سلوك جيمي الأخير وتحركاته الأخيرة، تدرك أنه قد لا يكون ضحية بريئة في نهاية المطاف.

3.o: يوم بيب في المحكمة يثبت أنه أصعب مما كانت تتخيل، بينما تأتي خيوط واعدة حول جيمي من مصدر غير متوقع

4.o: تجبر الأدلة الجديدة بيب على العودة إلى خط التحقيق الأول بإلحاح متجدد، بينما تسبب شهادة ماكس هاستينغز في موجات صدمة في أرجاء المحكمة.

5.o: تتسبب مهمة ليلية جريئة في توتر المجموعة وعزل بيب. تتعثر قضية جيمي حتى يفك بيب شفرة دليل يكشفها بالكامل. وفي المحكمة، يُصدر الحكم.

6.o: في سعيهم وراء الحقيقة، تواجه بيب وأصدقاؤها مخاطر جديدة واكتشافات صادمة. هل سيجدون جيمي وينجون سالمين؟

1.o: Christine's 8-year-old son, Ritchie has been accepted into a posh private school where Christine encounters two snooty class moms, Marly and Lindsay, who can't seem to grasp the concept that Christine actually works. Her 20-something slacker brother, Matthew, lives with her, but in a pinch, also serves as Ritchie's babysitter.

2.o: When Christine learns that Richard and "new" Christine are enjoying an intimate relationship, she becomes determined to make her own conquests. After several failed attempts to meet eligible men, she finally runs into a guy named Stan at the grocery store. Unbeknownst to Christine, Stan is a father at Ritchie's school who is known as "Sad Dad."

3.o: When Christine learns that her close friends, Barb and Pete, are responsible for introducing Richard to his "new" Christine, she allows them to set her up on a blind date of her own. After a series of unsuccessful dates, she finds the possibility of love in the strangest of places. Meanwhile, Matthew takes Ritchie to swimming lessons.

4.t: One Toe Over the Line Sweet Jesus
4.o: Richard learns from a gloating Matthew that Christine is out enjoying her fifth date with a new beau, Burton, so he does what any self-respecting ex-husband would do: he sabotages the happy couple's goodnight kiss and insults Burton with lawyer jokes. But when he tries to make it up to them by inviting Christine and Burton to dinner with him and "new" Christine, his best-laid plans go awry.

5.o: After 10 dates, Christine faces a critical moment in her relationship with Burton. Will she or won't she? Let him in the house, that is, to meet her son, Ritchie. She eventually relents, only to be thrown for a loop later.

6.o: Concerned about the uniformity of Ritchie's schoolmates, Christine takes it upon herself to help diversify the student body at his private school.

7.o: Following Christine's breakup with Burton, everyone expects Christine to fall apart emotionally, but she insists she is fine and looking forward to spending time with her best friend: "me." But after being humiliated while dining out alone, Christine realizes she really did care for Burton, which drives her even crazier.

8.o: Christine feels pressured to throw an extravagant party for Ritchie's 9th birthday, his first involving other children from his new private school. Recoiling from sticker shock after meeting with a ritzy event planner, Christine decides to have an arts and crafts party at her home, with mixed results.

9.o: Christine tries not to have a meltdown when her ex-husband, Richard, brings his "new" Christine with him to pick up Ritchie and take him to breakfast so that they can get to know one another. By day's end, Christine tries to pull herself together to make a good impression at parents' night at Ritchie's school, but is caught off guard when "new" Christine shows up as well.

10.o: Christine's former marriage counselor comes into the gym, leading to some awkward moments between the two women. When Christine mentions this to Richard, his cryptic reaction leads her to question whether it was in the counselor's best interest to encourage their divorce. Meanwhile, Matthew finds Christine's wedding video in a box of old photo albums, and Christine takes a trip down memory lane.

11.o: Christine objects when Richard and "new" Christine want to take Ritchie to a Rolling Stones concert. Fearing that Ritchie is too young to be exposed to sex, drugs and rock and roll vices on display at a Rolling Stones concert, Christine initially forbids it. Eventually, she relents but immediately regrets her decision and, in a panic, goes to the venue with Matthew to see if she can sneak into the concert in order to keep tabs on Ritchie.

12.t: Some of My Best Friends Are Portuguese
12.o: Shut out once again by the cliquey, judgmental moms at Ritchie's school, Christine runs into a down-to-earth working woman, Belinda, who invites her over for a drink after work. Belinda's job, however, isn't quite the type of position Christine expected her to hold, which throws yet another wrinkle in her attempt to fit in with the other school parents.

13.o: Christine volunteers to help out at Ritchie's spring carnival and while there, she runs into the mean moms -- Marly and Lindsay -- who are clucking over the attractive father of a new student at Westbridge. Christine is excited to learn that the hot dad is her ex-boyfriend, Burton, but her hopes of re-igniting their romance are shot down when she learns Burton has a new girlfriend.

1.o: Since "New" Christine broke up with Richard, he's been spending a lot of time at her house, leading Ritchie to believe that his parents are back together. When Christine tells Richard that Ritchie told this to his new teacher, Mr. Harris, Richard suggests that they give their relationship another try.

2.o: Richard tells Christine that the reason he has good luck with women is that he "says yes to life." When Christine meets a good-looking man after paying a surprise visit to New Christine, she decides to break out of her mold and says yes when he asks her out to dinner.

3.o: Christine is stunned to find out the man she's seeing, New Christine's father, is also a grandfather.

4.o: Ritchie goes to church with Richard and new Christine without consulting his mother first, leaving old Christine to explain and explore her aversion to organized religion.

5.o: Barb moves in with Christine after deciding to divorce her husband. This forces Matthew into Ritchie's room, where he discovers his nephew has some odd habits.

6.o: Christine runs into Stan again and is unable to resist him, despite her best efforts.  She asks Matthew to help keep Stan away from her, but her brother is having attraction issues of his own--his latest girlfriend refuses to leave.

7.o: Christine's attraction to Ritchie's teacher causes a scene at a school fund-raiser--especially after she wins a playdate with the man.

8.o: Christine makes sacrifices so she can pay for Ritchie's school tuition.

9.o: After Richie begins showing more interest in spending time with Richard and then does a bad job on his school homework project, Christine contemplates bailing Richie out in an attempt to win him over again.

10.o: Christine has trouble working with Barb at the gym and feels pressure at home to find a nanny for Ritchie when Richard is unavailable to care for him due to a trip with New Christine.

11.o: When Christine's environmentally-friendly hybrid car and Marly's gas-guzzling monster SUV hit one another, it becomes a bigger dispute than simply who hit whom. While her car is in the shop, Christine is forced to go against her principles and rent a luxury SUV when no other car is available.

12.o: Richard want Ritchie to learn the value of competition and male bonding, and signs him up for soccer. Christine disagrees, but then has her own competitive urges when fighting with Richard for attention from Mr. Harris.

13.o: Christine can't help but meddle in Matthew's love life when she meets his ex-girlfriend at a party. Meanwhile, Richard hopes to get Ritchie enthused about his contracting job.

14.o: Jealous that New Christine benefits from all the positive qualities she instilled in Richard during their marriage, Christine spites her by revealing to Richard that she gave New Christine the idea for the birthday gift she gave him.

15.o: Christine finds out her new sleep medication caused her to embarrass herself over the phone.

16.o: Christine finds out Richard's brother is gay, but not until after sleeping with him.

17.o: Christine vows to become more aware of politics when Richard scolds her about her indifference towards an upcoming election setting a bad example for Ritchie.

18.o: Trying to send an e-mail to Barb about Mr. Harris, Christine ends up sending it to all the parents from school, nearly costing him his job.

19.o: When Christine learns that Richard has been hired to remodel "meanie mom" Lindsay's bathroom, she can't help but intervene to make sure he doesn't screw up the job and risk their reputation at Ritchie's school. Additionally, she and Richard are at odds over which of them gets to be the one to give Ritchie the sex talk.

20.o: The stresses of going to a wedding with Richard and Barb are multiplied by Christine's agreeing to be designated driver, depriving her of some much-needed alcohol.

21.o: On their way to Ritchie's desert camping trip, Christine, Richard, Matthew, and Barb stay at a seedy motel and get on each others' nerves.

22.o: Christine realizes that one reckless evening may have jeopardized her chance to begin dating Mr. Harris.

1.o: Christine and Mr. Harris try to establish a relationship before having sex, but Barb gives her pause. Matthew is horrified when he sees his med school cadaver was a neighbor.

2.o: Insecurity over a waitress flirting with Daniel sends Christine to a plastic surgeon's office.

3.o: Roles reverse when Christine's dubbed a "meanie mom" by a father at Ritchie's school who finds Marly and Lindsay to be to his liking.

4.o: Ritchie's soccer match leaves Christine running late for an event she's supposed to be attending with Mr. Harris.

5.t: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
5.o: Christine tries to get over breaking up with Daniel. Matthew learns the source of his intimacy issues is not his mother, but Christine.

6.t: The New Adventures of Old Christine
6.o: Christine hesitantly allows New Christine to arrange a blind date for her and finds her intuition against the idea was spot on.

7.o: Christine finds herself forced to feign happiness when she covets the house Richard and New Christine have purchased.

8.o: Christine hopes acting a bit more wild will stop Barb thinking she's uncool.

9.o: Christine tries to forbid Barb and Matthew from letting a night of passion bloom into a full-blown relationship.

10.o: Christine tries to control her hormones when her gynecologist says she may be entering perimenopause.

1.o: Christine offers to marry Barb to help her stave off deportation. Meanwhile, Richard looks to pop the question to New Christine.

2.o: Richard begs Christine for the return of her old wedding ring which was an heirloom from his mother, in hopes of giving it to new Christine when he proposes.

3.o: Barb's profile in a business journal brings in new clientele.

4.o: Christine has been burning the candle at both ends -- working hard and trying to be a good mom. Ritchie decides he wants to join the reptile club at school and tells Christine all she needs to do is get the permission slip in on time. When Christine realizes that she's forgotten yet again, she asks the Reptile Guy (Jeffrey Tambor) to make an exception. He says the only way he'll consider is if Christine will go on a date with him. As creepy as he is, Christine is determined not to let Ritchie down, and so she complies.

5.t: Everyone Says I Love You Except Ritchie
5.o: Christine is distraught when Ritchie stops saying "I love you" to her. When she reveals her distress to Matthew, she also admits that she's been sleeping in Ritchie's room every night. Matthew tells her that if she's not careful, Ritchie will end up like him -- he can't go to sleep without talking to their mother. They spend the night helping each other break these habits.

6.t: Tie Me Up, Don't Tie Me Down
6.o: Christine and Barb prepare for a casual, non-relationship-seeking double date with two guys they meet at a video store, but jealousy arises when only one of them gets asked out for a second date.

7.t: So You Think You Can Date
7.o: Christine and Richard have a dinner date with her new boyfriend, Patrick, (Tim DeKay a.k.a. Bizarro Jerry on "Seinfeld") returns as her date.

8.o: A talent scout caught Ritchie's great school performance and he liked what he saw and offered him a audition to do a TV commercial, much to a thrilled Christine, but Richard won't approve of it and refuses to like him go.

9.o: Christine thinks she has the perfect boyfriend, until he has a 'bizarre' reaction to her competitiveness after losing to her at tennis.

10.t: Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner?
10.o: Over a Thanksgiving visit, the discovery of a shared secret gives Christine a way to negate one of her mother's criticisms.

11.o: The parent company of Christine and Barb's gym franchise comes for an inspection and discovers that they have broken a contractual clause, risking the entire business. New Christine wants Richard to get a vasectomy.

12.o: The girls change their building into a spa after learning that they can't get a loan to keep their gym afloat.

13.o: Christine tries to make a good impression at the Parents Orientation. However, her behavior is anything but good when she recognizes one of the fathers as the boy she knew in junior high.

14.t: What Happens in Vegas Is Disgusting in Vegas
14.o: New Christine loosens up during a bachelorette party Christine and Barb throw in Vegas.

15.o: With Barb and Mathew moving out and Ritchie leaving for science camp, Christine wants to prove she can take care of herself.

16.t: Honey I Ran Over the Kid
16.o: After Ritchie hurts himself at a skateboarding party, Christine accuses Richard of bad parenting, and they begin competing to prove each other wrong. Matthew gets involved in a rebound relationship.

17.o: At first Christine is impressed when another mother considers her a "rock," but soon finds it's exhausting being responsible.

18.o: Christine and Richard help Marly and Lindsay through labor, bring back memories of Ritchie's birth which, in turn, brings back feelings for one another.

19.o: After the mothers at Ritchie's private school continue to take cheap shots at Christine, Christine decides to enroll him in public school.

20.o: Mathew gets assistance in losing weight from fitness 'expert' Christine, but she soon realizes she can't shed off a few pounds herself.

21.o: Hoping to show she's fine with Richard and New Christine's wedding, Christine feigns being in love with Todd Watski—a ruse that proves difficult to pull off when he acts boorishly at the rehearsal dinner. Meanwhile, Matthew has an encounter with New Christine's sister, Amy.

22.o: Christine finds out a secret about Jeff after they rekindle feelings for each other at Richard and New Christine's wedding. Matthew continues to date Amy, and Barb meets a possible love interest.

1.o: Christine and Matthew fly to the Bahamas to get Barb an illegal visa after she was arrested by immigration during Richard and New Christine's wedding ceremony.

2.o: A trip with Barb to retrieve some of Richard's things sees Matthew worry that New Christine isn't letting out her feelings over the wedding fiasco. Meanwhile, Christine and Richard meet up with some of their friends from college and are shocked to see how badly they've aged.

3.o: Old Christine finds a suspicious mole on her left breast, and overreacts, thinking shes dying. Meanwhile, Richard tries to negotiate with New Christine regarding their house.

4.o: An aggressive divorce attorney is hired by Christine after being convinced that Barb owes her alimony.

5.o: Christine starts seeing a therapist who's Matthew's mentor, but they are both confused on whether they want to have a professional or romantic relationship. Richard and New Christine have trouble adapting to living under the same roof.

6.t: The Curious Case of Britney B.
6.o: When Ritchie is asked to a dance by the most popular girl in school, Christine believes that she is popular by association and has finally surpassed the Meanie Moms. 2.o: يحاول علي العودة للحياة العادية بعد تعرض ممتلكاته للتخريب من خلال إصلاح نوافذ الحي المكسورة. يخطط أوغوز لإيجاد منزل دائم لإلميرا.

3.o: يبحث جاكسون عن أدلة للعثور على المهاجم الذي صوب المسدس على رأس شقيقه. يتحد الحي بأكمله لدفع تكاليف العملية الجراحية لنافع الذي أصيب في عينيه أثناء الانفجار.

4.o: يُخرِج علي أرجان من الحبس بكفالة على خلفية بيعه للأسماك الفاسدة، لكن هذا الموقف لا يجعل أرجان يتراجع عن طموحه. تأتي الشرطة لمنزل السيدة ماريكا، فتهرب ألميرا.

7.o: ترسل إلميرا رسالة إلى جهات الاتصال الخاصة بها في إيطاليا لقناعتها بضرورة مغادرة تركيا. يعرض سامي على علي فرصة العمل في مناقصة حكومية بمدينة يوزغات.

8.o: يتم الكشف عن هوية إلميرا بعد نزول الشرطة السرية إلى الحي والتحقيق معها. تؤدي أعمال علي الصالحة أخيراً إلى نتائج مثمرة ويجري نافع العملية الجراحية ليرى الدمار الذي نجم عن الانفجار.

1.o: Promoted as the youngest DCP of the Mumbai Crime Branch, Rita Ferreira must battle a patriarchal mindset at work, her own impostor syndrome, and a returning addiction, all while she gets drawn to a murder investigation that hits far too close to home.

2.o: Succeeding in covering her secret, Rita begins making headway in the case, uncovering an unsettling trail of killings that are connected by a pattern that's hard to ignore.

3.o: Her relationship with Aditya in tatters, Rita gets mired in her investigation with the discovery of another murder bearing the same signature, guilt now blurring the line between duty and conscience.

4.o: As the city grapples with two murders within a week, Vikram zeroes in on a suspect, but Rita refuses to follow his lead and pushes her investigation into overdrive, turning the case into a race against time.

5.o: Eager to close the case early, Deshpande backs Vikram's theory and lets him jump the gun - sidelining Rita, whose grip on the case slips even as her instincts pull her toward astounding new clues.

6.o: Another murder comes to light, leaving the department humiliated. Before Deshpande can lean on Rita again, her substance addiction is exposed to the world, pushing her to the brink of suspension.

7.o: A tantalizing chase brings DCP Rita Ferreira and the killer on a head-on collision course, but to defeat the killer, she must first confront the haunting memory she's long buried.
